title: Round 69 (F375): Sprite offset/anchor verification - EI frames carry uniform tile-grid offset (-24,-16) for 48x32 tiles (Cliffsc/SmObjectsc sampled) + client 0x43B440 dest math IGNORES WIL offsets (bottom-left anchor: destX=x*48-scrollX-200, destY=y*32-scrollY-h-125) + offset-distribution P9 confirmed
objective: Verify the sprite offset handling: EI WIL frames carry offsetX/offsetY in headers, but the client's tile blit (0x43B440) anchors bottom-left using frame height only (ignoring offsets). Confirm against the offset-distribution P9 evidence.
question: Does the client use WIL frame offsets for mid/front sprites, or anchor bottom-left ignoring them?
method: wilsdk frame-header offset sampling (Cliffsc/SmObjectsc); capstone verification of 0x43B440 dest math (0x43BCF5-0x43BD36); cross-ref offset-distribution-evidence.json (P9).

frame_offsets.Cliffsc: f100/f500/f1000 all offsetX=-24 offsetY=-16, w=48 h=32 - uniform tile-grid anchor (48x32 tile, sprite centered -24,-16)
frame_offsets.SmObjectsc: f50 off(-24,-16) 48x64; f200 off(-24,-16) 48x352 (tall object); f500 off(-24,-16) 48x32 - same -24,-16 anchor, heights vary
frame_offsets.pattern: all EI terrain frames use -24,-16 (half-tile) - NOT per-frame art offsets

client_anchor_0x43B440.dest_math: 0x43BCF5: dx = (x - viewX)*3<<4 - scrollX - 0xC8 (200); dy = (y - viewY)*5<<4 - scrollY - h(word[+2]) - 0x7D (125)
client_anchor_0x43B440.offset_usage: NO offsetX/offsetY read in the blit path - frame height only (bottom-left anchor)
client_anchor_0x43B440.vs_ground: ground -157 vs mid/front -125 (F331 comment) - differ by one cell height (32px)

cell_analysis.p9: offset-distribution-evidence.json: EI 3.0 frame offset (WIL +4/+6) nonzero distribution scanned; uniform -24,-16 for terrain confirmed

exe_trace.tile_render: 0x43B440 (F331): 0x460240 blit call at 0x43BCE6 (mid/front); frame h at word[+2]

audit_vs_exe.P9: offset distribution confirmed - terrain frames uniform -24,-16

contrast.offset_use: UI controls (0x417550) use frame offsets for rects; MAP sprites IGNORE offsets (bottom-left anchor) - two systems
contrast.tall_objects: SmObjectsc f200 h=352 (tall tree) still anchored bottom-left via height

verdict: Sprite offset/anchor verified (primary-bytes): EI terrain frames carry uniform -24,-16 (half-tile) offsets, but the client's 0x43B440 map blit anchors sprites bottom-left using frame height only (destY = y*32 - scrollY - h - 125), ignoring WIL offsets. offset-distribution P9 + F331 confirmed.
evidence_level_note: Frame headers read via wilsdk; dest math read directly from MIR3.EXE bytes.
tool: wilsdk frame headers; capstone via disasm_capstone.PeImage
reproduce: wilsdk header() on Cliffsc/SmObjectsc frames; img.disasm(0x43BCF5, 0x40)
notes: -24,-16 = half of 48x32 tile - frames pre-aligned to tile grid
mapviewer offset_mode param exists to experiment with offsets (F331 comment) - default ignores them like the client
tall sprites (h=352) extend upward from bottom-left anchor correctly
